Hi! I'm a precision-medicine methodologist with particular interest in dose individualization esp. in oncology. Currently working through MIL aiming to learn enough Lean to formalize [1] this Fall. Beyond ensuring the correctness of the paper, I hope this formalization process also yields fresh insight into the structure of my argument, à la https://mathoverflow.net/q/514460.

  1. Norris DC. Dose-Escalation Trial Protocols that Extend Naturally to Admit Titration. July 2, 2025 arXiv:2507.01370v1 [math.CT]
